source.subject: mathematics
source.authorityName: Central Board of Secondary Education (content created by the British Council)
source.notes: A bank of practice items for teachers (not an examination paper); the document says it contains 58 items (question IDs), extracted here as sub-questions. Items map to the NCERT books current in 2021; chapters were mapped to the current NCERT syllabus (Ganita Prakash) and must be confirmed. The `number` field holds the printed item identity (e.g. Maths6AS1) because every item is numbered '1' inside the bank. Answers are from each item's own mark scheme. Marks are those printed with the question; where the item metadata disagrees, this is flagged.
source.usage: Official CBSE item bank, freely available on cbseacademic.nic.in for teachers to use as they wish; question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.
